节点.功能描述: Opens the notification extension subscription settings page of the application, which is displayed in semi-modal mode and can be used to set the notification enabling and notification mode. This API uses a promise to return the result.
注释信息: @param { UIAbilityContext } context - Ability context bound to the notification settings page.
@returns { Promise<void> } The promise returned by the function.
@throws { BusinessError } 201 - Permission denied or current device not supported.
@throws { BusinessError } 1600018 - The notification settings window is already displayed.
@throws { BusinessError } 1600023 - The application does not implement the NotificationSubscriberExtensionAbility.

parameters.说明: Ability context bound to the notification settings page.

节点.return_description: The promise returned by the function.

error_codes.description: Permission denied or current device not supported.
Internal error.
The notification settings window is already displayed.
The application does not implement the NotificationSubscriberExtensionAbility.
